title: Kamui: Intangibility
body:
Syntax: perform kamui intangibility

Description: Kamui phases the caster through incoming attacks for three rounds. Requires an active Sharingan and this Mangekyo eye technique assigned; authenticated immortals can test every Mangekyo technique without those gates. It is not a normal level unlock. Costs 40 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 60 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
